title: review_identity capture hits its 40 s deadline on a Flutter repo with submodules, blocking a review from starting
outcome: No scanner change. Ordinary TermAl review adopts the shared source_id under the separate procedure item. Comovo owns its own review transition to the same source_id under Greg's direct instruction; Git ranges select the reviewed content.
acceptance: TermAl's ordinary review and resume paths identify the review input only by the shared source_id (moved there by w-53eb82ce27a1) and never call the raw full-environment review identity, including as a fallback.
The Comovo unblock is recorded as Comovo's own procedure change to the shared source_id (owner Comov::Codex), under Greg's word.
No new scanner, gate or capture variant is added; the raw tool stays an unchanged explicit opt-in.
